title: Wave2 travel B=まは outer-frame prospect
purpose: Explore a new same-scene A-only outer-frame family from wave2 verified poems 90 and 93 without integrating wave2 into the fixed-50 baseline or inventing reverse-side lexical restoration.

key_operation_logic: The generated host B+C remains exactly the host's attested second-ku onset.
The imported donor A+B edge is attested because both sources share raw B=まは.
The mirrored reverse(B)+reverse(A) outer ending equals the donor's attested ku5 outer frame.
Therefore reverse_B lexical identity need not be globally restored or generalized for this A-only operation.

external_lexical_check.use: Supports that surfaced まはる can be a historical verb; it does not prove source glyphs or the exact sentence parse.

shared_B_review.conclusion: This pair is materially safer than raw-B-only matching because both B+C surfaces continue as まはる. Still, wave2 source images and full sentence parses remain pending.

research_value: Demonstrates an operation-specific shared-B case where forward B morphology is supported by identical B+C surface continuation.
